name: Create Order Ledger from Sales Order
script:
if frappe.db.exists(
    "Order Ledger",
    {"sales_order": doc.name}
):
    frappe.throw("Order Ledger already created for this Sales Order")

for item in doc.items:
    order_ledger = frappe.get_doc({
        "doctype": "Order Ledger",

        # Reference fields
        "sales_order": doc.name,
        "sales_order_item": item.name,

        # Optional but recommended fields
        "customer": doc.customer,
        "item": item.item_code,
        "qty": item.qty,
        "uom": item.uom,
        "order_date": doc.transaction_date,

        # Any default workflow/status fields
        "status": "Unassigned"
    })

    order_ledger.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
